content:
Last week saw notable discounts on a range of current Apple products, from the AirPods Pro 3 at 20% off to the latest AirPods Max 2 slashed by US$120, and the good news isn't over yet. While those deals are still live, Amazon has just dropped the price of Apple's 2026 AirTag 2 to an all-time low, with a single unit going for as little as US$20.

In last week's anniversary sales coverage, we highlighted several all-time low prices on the AirTag 2, but if you missed them, don't worry — the price has now dropped even further, setting the lowest price we've ever recorded.

Amazon is still selling the single-pack AirTag 2 for US$24, matching the best price seen since launch, while the four-pack has been reduced to US$79.99 with free shipping.

Apple's official four-pack retails for US$99, which is already better value than the standard US$29 single unit, and now at roughly 20% off, it's a brand-new all-time low, working out at just US$20 per AirTag 2 on average.

While the previous US$90 deal on the four-pack will most likely continue alongside major retailers' anniversary promotions for the entire week, this new all-time low from Amazon is a different story — no one can say for sure when the price will go back up.

We've previously compared the differences between the previous-generation AirTag and this year's AirTag 2 — you can check out the details here — but here's a quick recap:

  • Precision finding range extended up to 1.5 times further
  • Speaker volume up to 50% louder than the previous generation
  • AirTag 2 chime can be heard from up to twice as far away
  • Features 'an industry-first suite of anti-stalking safeguards'

AirTag 2 New Features Just Around the Corner

AirTag 2 has dropped to US$20 each, just in time ahead of next month's iOS 27 and watchOS 27 launches. For Apple Watch users, there's also a practical upgrade: the Find My app now supports Precision Finding, meaning you can use your Apple Watch to locate an AirTag with on-screen directional arrows and specific distance info.

watchOS 27 also unifies the Find My experience into a single app. Previously on Apple Watch, the Find My experience was split into three separate app icons — People, Items, and Devices — arranged in the app list or grid view.

As for iOS 27, it brings a new design and interface changes to the Find My app, making it easier for users to keep track of friends and belongings.

With that in mind, this price is absolutely the best time to expand your AirTag 2 collection.

More top Apple deals this week:

  • AirPods Max 2 — US$429 (originally US$549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 — US$190 (originally US$249)
  • AirPods 4 — US$99 (originally US$129)
